normalized.result: Yes, that's the right fallback. The manual form kept my address attached, gives me fields to add a title, description, and my own note, and it's honest that "a readable copy is not available yet" while telling me it'll keep trying to capture one after I save. So even when the page can't be reached, I can still save the link with my own context and not lose anything — and the app keeps working on the copy in the background. This works well for me.
